name: Crispy Chana Buddha Bowl
ingredients: 1 carrot, 1 cup broccoli and ½ cup beetroot, cubed
Dressing: 3 tbsp plain soy yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, ½ tsp grated garlic, salt
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chickpeas, tofu and vegetables with the oil and spices.
Roast for 25 minutes, shaking the tray once, until the chickpeas are crisp.
Divide the greens and quinoa between two bowls.
Top with the roasted mixture and drizzle with the dressing.
note: Dry the chickpeas thoroughly before roasting; moisture is what stops them crisping.
